title: Cancel a friend plan without a fake excuse
userNeed: The user wants to cancel an agreed social plan kindly without inventing an emergency.
inputPattern: I cannot make it tonight and want to be honest but not dramatic.
safetyNotes: Do not invent illness, emergencies or third-party blame.
Offer rescheduling only when the user has a real alternative.

title: Send a client delay update by email
userNeed: The user needs to communicate a delay without blaming a colleague or promising an unsafe deadline.
inputPattern: The client work is delayed and I need a professional update.
safetyNotes: Include only realistic timing that the user actually provided.

title: Set a short family boundary
userNeed: The user wants to set a boundary without diagnosing the other person or escalating the conflict.
inputPattern: I do not want to explain this again to my family member.
safetyNotes: Do not diagnose or label the other person.
State the boundary and one practical next step.

title: Ask for dating clarity without pressure
userNeed: The user wants clarity while respecting consent and non-response.
inputPattern: I want to ask where this is going without sounding pushy.
safetyNotes: Ask one clear question at most.
Avoid jealousy tests, pressure tactics or implied obligation.

title: Decline extra service scope
userNeed: The user needs to decline extra scope clearly without hostility.
inputPattern: A service provider or client is asking for more than I can do.
safetyNotes: Do not use hostile or punitive framing.
Keep the decline clear and practical.
